title: Ben Horowitz on Venture Capital and AI
thesis: This episode argues that despite the 'SaaS apocalypse,' the speaker remains bullish on Navon, citing accelerated revenue and a public market price recovery from $8 to $15 with a potential to reach $30. The speaker also notes that Anthropic is currently hiring a travel manager to manage the Navon relationship, indicating they are not ignoring the opportunity.

claims.claim: The speaker believes Navon will be fine for a very long time despite the SaaS apocalypse, citing accelerated revenue and a public market price recovery from $8 to $15 with a potential to reach $30.
claims.quote: Navon lost two thirds of its value in the SaaS apocalypse. And it's, you know, accelerated revenue since then. It's, you know, I think I mean, I got to be careful because it's a public company and so forth. But like I think they'll be fine for a very long time.

claims.claim: The speaker predicts Navon's stock price will likely reach $30 if they put two more quarters in the road.
claims.quote: So if you look at the Navon socket, it was at like $25, it went to $8. It's out $15. If they put two more quarters in the road, probably be at $30.
